title: a reactor whose loop saves a row per iteration and then fails on a later row leaves none of its effects
note: Gate for D-REACTION-TX (docs/decisions).  A reactor body is one transaction on every backend, whether or not the event was claimed in the consumer inbox: a writing loop that fails part-way keeps none of its saves, in an event-started `create` and in an `on` reactor of a started workflow.
